claim: The 2000-row EMBER subset has row-level SHA-256 identity and no exact duplicate feature vectors
evidence_scope: Identity audit and locked dataset/manifest hashes
wording_rule: Call it an identity-audited subset; do not imply the official full EMBER protocol

claim: U+H improves ROC-AULC and AP-AULC over Random
evidence_scope: Five outer folds and five seeds per fold
wording_rule: Report effect sizes and 5/5 fold direction

claim: XAI-Full reduces training labels to target relative to Random
evidence_scope: Mean 92-label or 15.8 percent reduction under the declared target
wording_rule: State that validation labels and full-pool reference cost are additional

claim: XAI-Full is the best acquisition policy
evidence_scope: U+H leads AULC and U+V uses the fewest labels
wording_rule: State that no variant wins every criterion

claim: Explanation-guided variants stably improve low-FPR behavior over Uncertainty
evidence_scope: Differences at 1 and 5 percent FPR caps are small and mixed
wording_rule: Report all operating-region metrics without dominance language

claim: Top-SHAP deletion produces larger AUC drops than uniform random deletion
evidence_scope: 25 models; mean and median baselines; k=10,25,50

claim: TreeSHAP explanations are executable-valid or causal
evidence_scope: Feature-space replacements can violate PE constraints
No validated normalization or aggregation rule

claim: The study detects ransomware or zero-day families
The confirmatory run was independently replayed in this cloud revision
evidence_scope: Readiness report records replay; named commits are absent locally
wording_rule: Attribute verification to retained report and require pre-submission replay

claim: The 199-sample fusion pilot proves full PID superiority
evidence_scope: P leads mean AUC/AP; PI and PID make identical decisions
wording_rule: Use as future multi-stage motivation, not a principal result
